object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G8 (D-G8), Q-G4; review Q38. An error raised on each repaint is logged each time, and a log without a limit can fill the disk, after which each save fails. 10 MB holds thousands of stack traces. Decided on 2026-11-11, to confirm.
object.description: The GUI should keep the error log at most 10 MB, removing the entries written first.
